Container.Name: wharf
Container.Overview: Single container that hosts and manages all your self-made AI tools (Python and Node web apps). Dashboard to install, start, stop, and tail logs for each tool. Each tool gets a dedicated port from the mapped range (up to 50 tools at once). IMPORTANT: the tool port range mapping must be 1:1 same-numbered (8100-8149 to 8100-8149) and must match the TOOLS_PORT_RANGE variable.

Config.Name: Tool port range
Config.Description: Ports for the tools themselves (up to 50 at once). MUST be mapped 1:1 with the same numbers and match TOOLS_PORT_RANGE.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Tools, venvs, logs, and state live here. Drop tool folders into tools/ inside this share.

Config.Name: TOOLS_PORT_RANGE
Config.Description: Must match the mapped tool port range exactly.

Config.Name: SEED_EXAMPLES
Config.Description: Copy example tools into an empty tools dir on first start

Config.Name: AUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Sets the dashboard login password on first boot (recommended if exposing Wharf externally). Leave blank to keep the dashboard unauthenticated.
